## History

Robert Bell originally owned and operated a farm that adjoined the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) place on the west. In early April, prior to [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's return home from Queen's, he sold his property. Following the sale of his farm, he moved to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P5](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0005)_
